posts.name: LewdDolphin21
posts.cooked: Insula Primalis for me as well. Two Reactive Platings and a Charged Attacks with no ongoing destruction on the hero's side initially seemed scary, but the environment and Ra paired up well--the first environment play was Volcanic Eruption, and Ra had Flesh of the Sun God in hand, so together the environment took out all of Ambuscade's devices as well as 5+2+3+3 damage dealt to Ambuscade (due to device destruction), at the cost of 0+3+3+3 (or 0+4+4+4 to Haka) to the heroes. The next round another device was played, resulting in 7+3 damage to Ambuscade at the cost of 3 (or 4) damage to heroes. The final round Haka took out Ambuscade with a Haka of Battle. In all, the environment and Ambuscade combined almost did more damage to Ambuscade than the heroes, lol. The only unfortunate thing was Unity didn't get a good chance to play bots, since Flesh of the Sun God only protects hero character cards, but oh well.

posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked:
By the time I realized I had Flesh, I had already destroyed the Volcanic Eruption. The early game was scary, but I used all of Tempest's card draw to get Ball of Lightning. Once Charged Attacks was gone, I quickly took control. The only regret I had was that I wasn't able to use the epic Haka of Battle I'd been saving up. I didn't play any of the Mere's, and Taiaha was acquired on my last turn. Unity managed to have Two Raptor Bots and a Champion Bot in play and took out over half of Ambuscade's remaining health making it easy for Ra and Tempest to finish him off.

I actually like the difficulty of the One Shot. Games that would normally be a bit lack luster are made more tense and exciting by the knowledge that you can't take back sub obtimal plays if you want that mint cover. I wouldn't be against higher difficulty fights, but right now, I'm okay with where it's at.
